operators.name: layer_norm_forward
semantics: Performs Layer Normalization over the last dimension (normalized_shape=512) for each batch and token.
Computes mean and variance over the last dimension, normalizes input as (input - mean) / sqrt(var + eps).
If weight is not None, multiplies normalized output by weight; if bias is not None, adds bias.
Matches torch.nn.LayerNorm with elementwise_affine=True, eps as passed, on CUDA float32 tensor.
Preserves input shape [16, 16384, 512] and returns contiguous tensor.

operators.name: mean_dim_forward
semantics: Computes the mean of the input tensor along dimension 1, reducing over the sequence length.
Output shape is [16, 512] with dtype float32 on CUDA, contiguous.
Stable mean computation to avoid precision issues for large sequence length 16384.
Applies LayerNorm over normalized_shape=512 with eps=1e-05, weight and bias from state_dict.
Input and output tensors are float32 on CUDA with shape [16, 16384, 512].
Output is stored as new tensor x.
Computes mean over dimension 1 of the layer normalized tensor.
Output shape [16, 512], float32 on CUDA, contiguous.
Value identical to the mean tensor from step_002.
